# Engine attribution and corresponding source

This distribution packages ONLYOFFICE/CryptPad conversion and PDF-reading code under GNU AGPLv3 with the upstream additional terms. Small wrapper/package MIT labels do not replace the engines' licenses. Preserve copyright headers, legal and modification notices, the ONLYOFFICE logo, applicable license text, and corresponding source/build instructions. See ONLYOFFICE-AGPL-3.0.txt and https://www.onlyoffice.com/license-faq . The original MIT application core retains its separate attribution.

## Exact distributed engines

The converter is locally modified and built from CryptPad v9.3.2+3 source at 7debf5e6d6d4f19874d764cd34446f7e63c6bc32. converter-provenance.json preserves the unchanged official upstream release/build association and historical output pins. converter-build-provenance.json separately records this project's actual source build, compiler, editable patches, tests and distributed output pins. The modifications select the existing PNG encoder without the renderer's 1200-pixel resampling policy, and select Xpdf's existing vendored IJG8c decoder branch. No PDF parser or JPEG decoder is written here. This preserves decoded raster dimensions and pixels through export; container/compressed bytes change, and PDF color conversion can differ from other viewers. The actual before/after regression includes original PNG calibration, independent upstream IJG CLI output, and a test-only public IImageStorage observer before the unchanged exporter. The observer is not in the distributed runtime. Historical unpinned upstream dependencies and historical host packages remain labeled separately; current build inputs are explicitly pinned. See provenance/BUILD.md for reproduction scope and requirements.

The maintained native patches also retain original BMP/TIFF raster dimensions, TIFF straight alpha and orientation, and the existing native XHTML/CSS import profile. The Emscripten image profile disables unsupported HEIF decoding rather than calling missing HEIF functions. PDF changes preserve source Unicode/ActualText and font identity, record source text/drawing/page associations, and use the existing converter's table and normal paragraph modes with verified sidecar metadata. Native graphics patches retain path/clip identity and straight/premultiplied alpha conventions. These are modifications to the established native engines; the application does not add a document viewer, editor or PDF codec. Native SharePoint reflow can change placement and layout, so these source/content checks do not claim identical page appearance.

The Word bundles were built from official ONLYOFFICE sdkjs 679a6d70ccb5487924f034cea089ff30daeeb7fd (v9.3.0.133) using upstream compile-word --map --level=SIMPLE, a pinned compiler and complete npm shrinkwrap. sdk-build-provenance.json records inputs, environment and output hashes. A fresh source extraction reproduced both distributed bundle hashes. No SDK JavaScript/Grunt logic patches were applied. Build scripts are under ../scripts/word-sdk-inputs/ and ../scripts/build-word-sdk.mjs.

The PDF drawing runtime is rebuilt from official core d54f0326cd67ef0d59b87af1c3ff51d678f77a39, associated with sdkjs 1b1c0fd7f886a00cf7c9e7eaef43704a53d20a59 by the publisher's DocumentServer v9.3.0 release. Its build removes USE_OPENSSL_HASH to select the existing upstream Xpdf SHA-384/SHA-512 branch; no hash implementation is written or replaced. OpenSSL include paths and source-touch hooks are omitted, and no OpenSSL implementation source/header/library is present in the drawing build. This project's guarded CPdfReader::GetInfo modification reports XFA presence and the root AcroForm field count through the existing parsed catalog; it adds no PDF parser or byte scanner. The readable generated bootstrap retains its original legal header. drawing-build-provenance.json pins source, exact editable changes, compiler packages, build recipe and outputs, with capability evidence and the generated source diff under provenance/drawing/. The font runtime remains byte-identical to the publisher-linked SDK. sdk-runtime-provenance.json records both source associations. ChartStyles.js is unchanged readable official source from sdkjs 679a6d70.

The reader's maintained source observers additionally expose bounded Unicode/ActualText, source text order, font and graphics capabilities through the existing parsed PDF objects. They retain complete-source/error checks and the native renderer's bounded page captures when required. A guarded Type3 font-size correction and alpha bridge are included. QA alternate order scans and metrics observers are excluded from the distributed profile. Exact changed-source inventories and fresh build evidence accompany the runtime provenance.

Remaining static SDK initialization PNG/JSON files match official SDK blobs. AllFonts.js is the readable, modified font catalog from ranuts/document d1c9b03263aabe14789297f5c717fefff2fe4f0d; it is not an unmodified ONLYOFFICE catalog. Its preferred editable data, exact baseline/patch, codec and modification documentation are in provenance/sdk/catalog-source/. The AllFonts catalog does not bundle or download external font glyph files. The PDF WASM runtime does contain embedded base fonts; their applicable notices accompany the native runtime notices. Existing mirror changes are described in RANUTS-NOTICE.txt; this project does not adopt that project's logo-removal interpretation.

## Source and local execution

manifest.json pins each distributed file and its acquisition source. Run node ../scripts/vendor-engine.mjs to verify packaged files, or --fetch to acquire pinned files and regenerate the converter, drawing runtime and Word SDK from source. node ../scripts/collect-engine-source.mjs --output SOURCE_DIRECTORY collects and verifies source archives enumerated by the provenance records. The release corresponding-source archive must use the four preferred-source substitutions in provenance/source-delivery.json instead of the raw SDK/core acquisition archives, alongside the other collected archives, these records/recipes/catalog inputs, application source and dependency lockfiles. Exact excluded objects/examples and unchanged retained source/data indexes are recorded; unused incompatible prebuilt objects are not redistributed. See provenance/BUILD.md.

The Word SDK runs in an opaque-origin MV3 sandbox without extension APIs. Local bootstrap eval is restricted to that sandbox; the extension policy permits only packaged scripts and WASM. No editor web-apps shell, DocumentServer, macros, plugins, collaboration connection, PDF actions, remote executable code or remote fonts are enabled. Existing DOCY import and ApiDocument.ToJSON retain editable text and layout. Only nontext shapes are exported with the SDK's own ShapeToImageConverter; raster media and editable textboxes retain their original/structured representations.

Static SDK placeholder/cursor icons are CC BY-SA 4.0, attributed to Ascensio System SIA / ONLYOFFICE; see CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt. jQuery 3.7.1, Underscore 1.13.6 and XRegExp 3.0.0 retain MIT notices in JQUERY-LICENSE.txt, UNDERSCORE-LICENSE.txt and XREGEXP-LICENSE.txt. JSZip 3.10.1 uses its MIT option (JSZIP-LICENSE.markdown), with embedded pako/zlib notices retained. @xmldom/xmldom 0.9.12 is MIT (XMLDOM-LICENSE.txt), bundled by pinned esbuild flags in the acquisition script for strict worker XML validation. Apache POI simple.doc is an Apache-2.0 test fixture (APACHE-2.0.txt); its source is pinned in the fixture acquisition script.


## Maintained MIME parser

The raw MIME parser uses the unmodified source closure from @protontech/crypto 2.2.0 (Proton AG / ProtonMail WebPackages). Package metadata declares GPL-3.0; the jsmimeparser subtree includes its MIT notice, copyright (c) 2013 Joshua Cranmer. The unused mailParser.js source has an MPL-2.0 notice and is not included in the runtime bundle. Its notice and full license remain available with the complete upstream source archive. No unrelated cryptography modules enter the parser bundle.

Build recipe: scripts/build-mime-parser.mjs. Exact source, closure and runtime pins: mime-parser-build-provenance.json. Full license texts: provenance/PROTON-GPL-3.0.txt, provenance/PROTON-MIME-MIT.txt, provenance/PROTON-MPL-2.0.txt.
